source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The disgusting hybrid monsters continue their march toward the wall, but unable to reach it yet.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: One of them reaches the magically dark cube with Ogonob inside and lashes out with a tentacle, managing to hit Ogonob three times, but avoiding being grappled by the monster.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Back on the wall, Karsemine launches a Firebolt at the tripod monster, dealing massive damage igniting the many escaping gases.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Whether it's the sounds of gases ignited or screams of pain, the monster writhes in agony, but is still alive.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna and Bonogo both fail to resist the effect of the meatwings and are now compelled to only move to the monsters and consume them.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna climbs over and down the wall in an attempt to get to the closest meatwing, but still manages to resist long enough to attack the hybrid monster attacking Ogonob.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: With two powerful Eldritch Blasts the monster is destroyed, leaving behind a smoldering pile and crackling purple energy.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Ogonob then uses Misty Step to get within striking range of the tripod, but misses the attack.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo uses his Steady Aim ability and lines up a powerful shot at the hybrid.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The arrow does massive damage, pinning the creature to the ground, but the monster pulls itself back up, ripping and shredding its back.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Thrin tries to steady himself, but just starts to let panic set in and misses both of his shots at the monster.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Undeterred by the battle around them, the giant sewer monsters split up and head in different directions, but both continue toward the wall.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Baergrom readies himself and takes aim with his crossbow, only for it to jam.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Frustrated, he throws the crossbow down and grabs a short bow, loads an arrow and fires at the hybrid monster, lodging an arrow in its head.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: One of the tripod creatures lashes out at Ogonob now that they are in range, hitting them all three times before continuing on to the wall.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Before the monster can get far Ogonob reacts with an attack, landing a glancing blow.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The other tripod creature continues to be asleep; under the influence of Stafl's spell.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The group of meatwings all begin to fly closer to the wall, except one that goes straight for the sleeping tripod.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: It slams itself into the creature, killing itself, but awakening the monster.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The rest of the group create a wafting smell of meat, enchanting Thrin, Karsemin, Ephanna, Bonogo, Caelynn and Baergrom.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Again they are compelled to find and eat the monsters, but cannot attack them directly.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Two of the meatwings attack Ephanna and two attack Caelynn.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Seeing the team in danger, Stafl jumps up from being prone and casts Bardic Inspiration on Ephanna then casts Enemies Abound on the golem, attempting to confuse and have it attack its own allies.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The golem ignores everything around it and dashes to the wall, ready to start to break it down.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Seeing this, Lysandra recharges her Commanding Shout and commands Bonogo, Karesmine and Baergrom to all attack.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo and Baergrom attack meatwings; Baergrom deals a decent blow with his bow, while Bonogo uses his dagger to slice one to pieces.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine attacks the tripod, dealing damage with her short bow.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Lysnadra then removes the charm affecting Caelynn, who then uses a level 2 version of her spell Magic Missile, heavily damaging two meatwings and exploding a third.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: One of the hybrid creatures finally reaches the wall just below Bonogo and near Ephanna, where it begins to attack the wall, slowly chipping away the foundation.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine again attacks the tripod monster with a Firebolt, this time fully igniting the flesh, causing it to burst into flames and die.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: She then transfers her Hunter's Mark to the golem and learns it is immune to poison and charm, but weak to fire.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: So Ephanna uses Eldritch Blast twice on the golem, dealing big damage, its skin crackling with purple energy.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Ogonob attacks one of the meatwings that's charming its allies, and with one hit turns the creature into a cloud of flesh and gore.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Seeing the golem attacking the wall, Bonogo uses Steady Aim and throws a dagger at its leg, dealing damage and causing the monster to fall prone.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Then Bonogo turns his attention to one of the remaining meatwings for another kill.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Thrin takes aim and fires an arrow at the prone golem, and just as the arrow lands, whatever energy was holding the creature together finally collapses.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Parts begin to fall off as animal bodies and slime slough off and slide away.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: It appears the battle is going well so far, until one of the giant sewer monsters finally reaches the wall.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: It uses its length to slide up the wall and reach the top, then pulls the rest of its body up and on top, right in the middle of Lysandra, Thrin and Caelynn.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The other sewer monster moves in to attack Ogonob through the magical darkness, but misses.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: However, both monsters ooze out a sticky gel that now makes it difficult to move away from the creatures.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Seeing the immediate danger on the wall, Baergom uses his Bait and Switch ability, moving Thrin out of harm's way and boosting his own defence in the process, then uses his warhammer to deal a thunderous blow.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Turning to Bonogo, Baergrom then uses Commander's Strike to direct him to attack.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo chooses the sewer monster attacking Ogonob and with a well thrown dagger, skewers and kills the monster.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The remaining tripod creature turns its attention to Ephanna, loading up its third leg again, but this time launching a massive spike, impaling Ephanna and pulling them toward the disgusting monster.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The proximity to the monster causes Ephanna to lose the ability to pinpoint where the creature is.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: But before the creature can attack again, Stafl casts Sleep on the monster, who almost breaks out of the spell until Stafl uses Luck.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Lysandra can see that they have the advantage now and can push for a final assault on the remaining monsters.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: She recharges her Commanding Shout and directs Bonogo, Baergrom and Karsemine to attack.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo shoots an arrow into where he saw the hybrid monster enter the darkness, and manages to hit his target.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Baergom is about to bring his hammer down again on the sewer monster when an arrow from Karsemine flies past, impaling the monster, but in killing it sprays poison on Baergrom, Thrin and herself.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn holds her attack until she can see the hybrid or the tripod wakes up.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The remaining hybrid moves in to attack Ephanna, but is still blinded by the magical darkness.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: It swings wildly and misses the first attack, but hits with the second, dealing necrotic damage.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: After seeing Ephanna in trouble, Karsemine moves to the edge of the wall and takes aim at the hybrid monster.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Her first arrow sails past the creature, hitting Ephanna instead.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: She adjusts her aim and shoots again, this time landing a killing blow on the monster.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: With one monster left on the battlefield, both Ephanna and Ogonob join Caelynn in holding their attack until the team coordinates an attack on the sleeping tripod.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo readies the team, then takes the first attack.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: He deals critical damage on the incapacitated creature, dealing massive damage in his first attack before following it quickly with two more attacks.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: All at once Caelynn, Ephanna and Ogonob attack.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn's Magic Missile and Ephanna's Eldritch Blast pile on the damage.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Finally Thrin finishes off the writhing creature, ending the battle.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Surveying the field, Karsemine and Ephanna decide the first thing they should do is burn as many remaining piles of meat as they can.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: However, as soon as they cast Firebolt and Bonfire the remaining piles turn to goo and are sucked into the ground.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: With the battle over and full night upon them, the group must decide what to do next.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Something needs to be done with the refugees from Edge, while some members need a much needed rest to regain spells.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The group decides to split up along those lines: Ephanna, Stafl and Baergorm will stand watch at the wall above the gate, taking a short rest and recovering.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The others will go check on the town and create a plan for the refugees.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: As they are just about to head out, Caelynn makes a quick call to Grobnok.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: After some muffled noise, he answers her call and she tells him about both Edge and Mireward Reach.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: He is very frustrated, not used to not being able to make a plan and get things done.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: She attempts to get Grobnok's rockie-talkie connected with Lysandra's, but this will take some time.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: He will call them back the next day to check in.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: In the meantime, there is work to be done.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 24 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
